prompts.textures: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D top-down RPG interior texture atlas for Glitchlands. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square cells, edge-to-edge, no gaps, no labels, no objects, no text. Detailed cozy pixel art, muted honey oak, warm cream plaster, sage and slate tones matching a lush woodland village. Each cell is one repeatable material tile. Row 0 columns: horizontal oak floor planks; vertical oak floor planks; warm small stone floor squares; dark slate laboratory floor squares. Row 1: cream plaster wall with subtle vertical wood supports; cream plaster wall plain; pale stone brick wall; dark exposed timber wall. Row 2: light oak floor variant; sage ceramic kitchen floor; worn cream stone floor; darker oak floor variant. Row 3: narrow horizontal brown baseboard on cream plaster; horizontal dark timber wall cap on cream plaster; gray stone wall base; gray stone wall cap. All 16 textures fill their cell entirely, orthographic surfaces no perspective, no cast shadows, no edge vignette. Floor textures must repeat seamlessly with consistent edge colors. No decorative furniture or doors. Desired 1024 square atlas.
prompts.props: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production interior furniture sprite atlas for Glitchlands cozy woodland top-down RPG. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, evenly spaced equal square cells. ONE recognizable object per cell, no labels no text no characters. Slightly top-down frontal orthographic RPG camera, consistent direction; detailed crisp pixel art with honey oak, cream, sage, brass and slate palette. Genuine transparent alpha background. Every object fully inside its own cell with at least 10% clear margin, centered and bottom-aligned to a consistent baseline. No enclosing room or floor, no floating detached shadows. Row 0 left-to-right: wooden single bed with blue blanket and white pillow; tall wooden bookcase full of colored books; small writing desk with parchment and ink; low round wooden stool. Row 1: rectangular oak dining table with ceramic bowl; simple dining chair facing upward; waist-high kitchen cabinet; compact stone cooking stove with unlit hearth. Row 2: long professor laboratory workbench with brass tools and bottles; tiny fantasy computer on its own small stand with blank luminous green screen; book lectern with open book showing tiny abstract scribbles not readable text; sealed glass specimen dome on wooden pedestal containing a small luminous green bug-like orb. Row 3: cottage wall window with open green shutters; interior wooden exit doorway with dark opening and pale wood trim; leafy potted fern; small oval braided cream-and-blue rug. Make shapes usable as independent game sprites. No Nintendo designs, no watermark. Desired 1024 square atlas.
